title: Shift records: choosing a person and a fortnight
question: The sliding name chips go. How should Carly pick who and which fortnight? Each option's full mockup also shows the cleaner's view. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A Person picker + fortnight arrows
options.lineage: Same ‹ › arrows as the Fortnight hours sheet; picker like 'Who covers?'
options.thesis: A full-width 'Showing: Everyone ▾' picker, then ‹ Last fortnight · 12 – 25 Oct › with one summary line under it.
options.viewport: Back · Shift records · Showing: Everyone ▾ · ‹ Last fortnight 12 – 25 Oct › · '8 shifts · 23h 40m · 1 with no photos' · day list.
options.risk: Jumping 3 months back is 6 taps on the arrows; tapping the fortnight label opens a list for that.

options.label: B Two pickers side by side
options.thesis: [👤 Everyone ▾] [📅 12 – 25 Oct ▾] on one line, summary under.
options.viewport: Back · Shift records · two pickers · summary · day list.
options.risk: 'Last fortnight' always takes two taps, and long names and dates get cut at half width.

options.label: C Fortnight card with total hours
options.thesis: The person picker, then an outlined card: ‹ Last fortnight › with the fortnight's total hours big underneath.
options.viewport: Back · Shift records · picker · card with arrows and '23h 40m · 8 shifts' · day list.
options.risk: The pinned top gets taller, so fewer shifts fit on the screen.
